Institution: Agriculture, Land Reform and Rural Development
SubProgramme: Programme 3: Food Security, Land Reform and Restitution
Indicator: 5.5.1 Number of land claims settled
Outcome: Priority 2: Economic Transformation And Job Creation
Cluster: Not Applicable
ReasonforDeviation_Q1: The under- achievement of 43 claims in Quarter 1 is due to : offers rejected by claimants, Delays from claimants in accepting offers due to consultations they needed to make, Family disputes, Delays in submission of supporting documents necessary for conclusion of a settlement by claimants, Claimants divided over options, Delays in acquiring historical valuations from the office of the OVG, Delays in couriers and QCC postponements.
CorrectiveAction_Q1: There are 21 claims already presented at QCC held on 11 July 2024. Meeting with claimant families to try and solve the disputes. Options workshop to be conducted earlier in the settlement process so that it does not delay settlement at the Section 42D stage, following up with the office of the OVG and once the valuations have been obtained, offers will be submitted which would then be translated into Section 42D submissions.
ReasonforDeviation_Q2: Delays with verification due to the non-submission of the necessary documents i.e. ID copies and affidavits by claimants and beneficiaries, Non-cooperation of claimants, Family disputes resulting to delays in settlement of the claims, Split options on settlement of the claims and Some claimants are outside the Country so is difficult to conclude necessary documents.
CorrectiveAction_Q2: Regional offices to obtain the outstanding documentation from claims so that offers can be converted to Sections 42ds for settlement. To convene weekly performance meetings with Project Coordinators and Managers to monitor performance and address issues of split options. Engage Home Affairs and International Relations to trace those overseas.
ReasonforDeviation_Q3: Delay in receiving valuation reports from the valuers e.g. KwaZulu-Natal and Limpopo, Offers were rejected by claimants e.g. Eastern Cape and KwaZulu-Natal, Family disputes and change of settlement option which delayed conclusion of the claims e.g. KwaZulu-Natal
CorrectiveAction_Q3: Regional offices to follow-up and obtain outstanding valuations so that offers can be made to the claimants and Further negotiations to be undertaken where claimants have rejected offers and with families where there are disputes and changes in settlement options.
ReasonforDeviation_Q4: The over- achievement of 135 claims in Quarter 4 was due to settling multiple claims and offices implemented catch-up plans due to non-achievement of targets in previous quarters.

Adherence to waiting period between first and second letters for dismissals e.g. Eastern Cape and Limpopo
CorrectiveAction_Q3: Development of a bulk payment system currently in progress. The regions to correct and reroute payment parcels which will contributes to finalisation of 22 claims. Offices to report on dismissals once the waiting period has expired
